					<p><strong>Liverpool youngster Keyrol Figueroa made his first senior international start for Honduras and celebrated the occasion by scoring the only goal of the match. </strong></p>
<p>The 20-year-old is currently on loan at League Two’s Port Vale after showing he was ready for first-team football, though he has just one substitute appearance so far.</p><div class="code-block-center ai-viewport-1">

<div id="thisisanfield_desktop_incontent_1" data-freestar-ad="__336x280" style="display:block; margin:0 auto 20px auto; text-align:center; min-height:280px; max-width:336px; width:100%;">

<p>The international break, however, saw him handed his first-ever international start for Honduras, in their CONCACAF Nations League match against Jamaica.</p>
<p>Figueroa marked the moment by finding the net after just 14 minutes, holding off his defender and steering a low cross into the back of the net.</p>
<p>It means his first senior goal came on the international stage, with his club account at first-team level yet to be opened. </p>

<p>After the match, he was duly delighted, saying via <a href="https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/keyrol-figueroa-scores-winner-honduras-first-international-goal" target="_blank">LFC</a>: “Look what we did! The first goal! </p>
<p>“I’m very proud of this opportunity that I was given in the national team.</p>
<p>“I want to thank my mum, my dad, my family, the people who are very close to me, who have supported me since I was a kid. But this is the first one. Thank God. Let’s go for more.”</p><div class="code-block-center ai-viewport-2 ai-viewport-3">

<p>Figueroa, who scored 12 goals in 16 appearances for Liverpool’s U21s last season, made his senior international debut in June and signed a new contract with the club earlier in the summer.</p><div class="code-block-center ai-viewport-2 ai-viewport-3">
